P.name: Mirror Image
P.title: Template:Data LeBlanc/Mirror Image
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Mirror Image|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = LeBlanc
|skill        = I
|name         = Mirror Image
|icon         = Mirror Image.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} When {{ci|LeBlanc}} reaches low health, she creates a {{tip|clone|clone}} of herself and together they enter brief {{tip|invisibility}}.
|blurb2      = The clone will run forward to a random location, and lasts for a period.
|blurb3      = ''Mirror Image'' will go on cooldown upon triggering.
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, when '''LeBlanc''' is damaged to {{sti|health|{{as|40% '''maximum''' health}}}}, she creates a {{tip|clone}} of herself, after which they both instantly become {{tip|invisibility|invisible}} for 1 second.
|description2 = The clone can cast basic attacks with no effect and lasts 8 seconds. Upon spawning, it starts moving up to 1900 units toward a random direction in front of '''LeBlanc's''' movement, determined at the moment of its spawning.
|description3 = ''See [[LeBlanc#Pets|Pets]] for more details about '''LeBlanc's''' clone.''
|static       = 60
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self
|damagetype   = 
|spellshield  = 
|spelleffects = 
|projectile   = 
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|notes        = 
* The {{tip|clone}} has a [[Pets#Leash ranges|leash range]].
* If ''Mirror Image'' triggers while '''LeBlanc''' is tethering to a target with {{ai|Ethereal Chains|LeBlanc}} (or its {{ai|Mimic: Ethereal Chains|LeBlanc|Mimicked}} version), her clone will not produce a fake tether, giving away which is the real one. {{Bug|2}}
* Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the end of the attack windup.
}}

Q.name: Sigil of Malice
Q.title: Template:Data LeBlanc/Sigil of Malice
Q.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Sigil of Malice|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = LeBlanc
|skill        = Q
|name         = Sigil of Malice
|icon         = Sigil of Malice.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|LeBlanc}} projects an orb at the target enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and marking them for a short time.
|blurb2       = Her next damaging ability against the marked target will consume the mark to deal {{as|magic damage}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''LeBlanc''' projects an orb at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}} and marks them for {{fd|3.5}} seconds.
|leveling     = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|65 to 165}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}}}
|description2 = '''LeBlanc's''' next damaging {{tip|champion ability|ability}} against the marked target will consume the mark to deal the {{ccs|same {{as|magic damage}}|magic}} again.
|leveling2    = {{st|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|65*2 to 165*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*2}}% AP)}}}}
|description3 = ''Sigil of Malice's'' orb deals {{as|{{pp|10 to 146|formula= 2 + 8 * level, capped at level 18}}<!--stops at 18--> '''bonus''' magic damage}} against {{tip|minion|minions}} and refunds 100% of its {{sti|{{as|mana cost}}}} and 30% of its remaining {{sti|cooldown}} if either the orb or its mark's consumption kills the target.
|target range = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 700
|speed        = 2000
|cooldown     = 6
|cost         = 50
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|costtype     = Mana
|targeting    = Unit
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = Spell
|projectile   = True
|callforhelp  = true
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|notes        = 
* ''Sigil of Malice'' and {{ai|Mimic: Sigil of Malice|LeBlanc}} can detonate each other's marks.
* The floating damage text upon the mark's detonation currently displays a real [[File:Critical strike magic icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon for magic damage critical strikes]] critical strike icon instead of a success indicator.{{bug}}{{Unit-targeted cancel conditions}}
}}

W.name: Distortion
W.title: Template:Data LeBlanc/Distortion
W.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Distortion|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = LeBlanc
|skill        = W
|name         = Distortion
|icon         = Distortion.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|LeBlanc}} {{tip|dashes}} to the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies upon arrival. She leaves behind a return pad at her original location that lasts a few seconds, during which she can recast.
|blurb2      = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''LeBlanc''' {{tip|blinks}} to the return pad.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''LeBlanc''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies upon arrival and leaving a return pad at the cast location for 4 seconds. ''Distortion'' can be recast after {{fd|0.2}} seconds of the dash ending for the pad's duration.
|leveling     = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|75 to 235}} {{as|(+ 90% AP)}}}}
|icon2        = Distortion 2.png
|description2 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''LeBlanc''' {{tip|blink|blinks}} to ''Distortion's'' return pad, regardless of range.
|target range = {{dv|{{tt|600|Maximum dash range}}|{{tt|Global|Recast range}}}}
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|240|Damage radius around dash destination}}
|speed        = 1450
|cooldown     = {{ap|15 to 10}}
|cdstart      = on-cast
|cost         = {{ap|60 to 100}}
|costtype     = Mana
|cast time    = none
|queue time   = {{tt|{{fd|0.5}}|Initial cast}} / {{tt|{{fd|0.3}}|Recast}}
|targeting    = {{dv|[[Location-targeted|Location]]|[[Auto-targeted|Auto]]}}
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = spellaoe
|projectile   = 
|grounded     = True
|knockdown    = True
|outofrange   = Target at maximum range (first cast clamped)
|notes        = 
* ''Distortion'' has no minimum dash range.
* ''Distortion'' will be buffered and cast as soon as the cooldown ends if the player attempts to cast it within {{fd|0.5}} seconds of the cooldown ending.
** The {{sbc|recast}} will be buffered and cast as soon as it becomes available if the player attempts to cast it within {{fd|0.3}} seconds of it becoming available to cast.
*The initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
**Recasting the ability does not.
**{{ai|Mimic: Distortion|LeBlanc}} has the same properties.
* ''Distortion'' and {{ai|Mimic: Distortion|LeBlanc}} have independent return pads and '''LeBlanc''' can travel to both while they are active.
* ''Distortion's'' pad duration starts once the dash ends.
}}

E.name: Ethereal Chains
E.title: Template:Data LeBlanc/Ethereal Chains
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Ethereal Chains|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = LeBlanc
|skill        = E
|name         = Ethereal Chains
|icon         = Ethereal Chains.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|LeBlanc}} flings an illusory chain in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|tether|tethers}} the first enemy hit, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them.
|blurb2      = The tether lasts a brief time, after which the target is dealt {{as|magic damage}}, {{tip|true sight|revealed}}, and briefly {{tip|root|rooted}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''LeBlanc''' flings an illusory chain in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy it hits and forms a {{tip|tether}} between '''LeBlanc''' and the target for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}.
|leveling     = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|50 to 130}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}}}
|description2 = If the tether is not broken by the end of its duration, it fractures to deal {{as|magic damage}} to the target and {{tip|root}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}.
|leveling2    = {{st|Fracture Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 240}} {{as|(+ 85% AP)}}|Total Damage|{{ap|50+80 to 130+240}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40+85}}% AP)}}}}
|target range = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 950
|width        = {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 110
|tether radius= {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|865|Equivalent to 995 center-to-center range against the average enemy champion}}
|speed        = 1750
|cooldown     = {{ap|14 to 11}}
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|cost         = 50
|costtype     = Mana
|targeting    = Direction
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = Special
|spelleffects = spell
|projectile   = True
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|notes        = 
* Both the initial and the delayed damage can detonate {{ai|Sigil of Malice|LeBlanc}}.
* ''Ethereal Chains'' and {{ai|Mimic: Ethereal Chains|LeBlanc}} are separate debuffs, and can both be tethered to the same target without overriding each other. The {{tip|root}} duration for either one are unchanged.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the tether's application and initial damage but not the aftereffects of one already applied.
* The tether remains for a minimum of {{fd|0.25}} seconds regardless of distance. 
{{Effect at cast time end}}
}}
